headlines.title: OpenAI's Hail Mary: GPT-6.2 Astra and a $1.25 trillion bet
headlines.summary: OpenAI has gone quiet while Anthropic takes the IPO spotlight, but it hasn't been idle. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen breaks down what it's been doing, from ChatGPT handling a fifth of Google's searches and poaching Anthropic talent to a shrinking funding round, a compute crunch and the GPT-6.2 Astra model waiting in the wings.

headlines.title: Google Escalates Nvidia Rivalry With Specialized Versions of AI Chips
headlines.summary: Alphabet Inc.’s Google is rolling out a broader array of artificial intelligence chips, aiming to capitalize on its rapid ascent as a challenger to Nvidia Corp. in a market worth hundreds of billions of dollars.

headlines.title: Not AMD. Not Intel. This Is the Artificial Intelligence (AI) Chip Stock Nvidia Should Fear Most.
headlines.summary: AMD and Intel both offer alternative chip architectures to Nvidia's GPUs, but there's a bigger threat in the background.

headlines.title: How Will Amazon and Alphabet Handle Custom Silicon Efficiency and Grid Access Now?
headlines.summary: Amazon keeps its custom chips in-house while Google sells its chips to outside customers, and both strategies now collide with the same limit: power. One approach protects margins, and the other leans on borrowed money. Which one holds up?

headlines.title: The On-Site Power Duel: Bloom Energy vs. GE Vernova
headlines.summary: AI builders will not wait for the grid, so one company ships fuel cells to the fence line while another books turbines years ahead. Both stocks just got hammered, and only one has the cash to ride out what comes next.

description: Alphabet Inc. offers various products and platforms in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia-Pacific, Canada, and Latin America. It operates through Google Services, Google Cloud, and Other Bets segments. The Google Services segment provides products and services, including ads, Android, Chrome, devices, Gmail, Google Drive, Google Maps, Google Photos, Google Play, Search, and YouTube. It is also involved in the sale of apps and in-app purchases and digital content in Google Play and YouTube; and devices, as well as the provision of YouTube consumer subscription services, such as YouTube TV, YouTube Music and Premium, NFL Sunday Ticket, and Google One. The Google Cloud segment offers consumption-based fees and subscriptions for AI solutions, including AI infrastructure, Vertex AI platform, and Gemini enterprise. It also provides cybersecurity, and data and analytics services; Google Workspace that include cloud-based communication and collaboration tools for enterprises, such as Calendar, Gmail, Docs, Drive, and Meet; and other enterprise services. The Other Bets segment sells transportation and internet services. Alphabet Inc. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Mountain View, California.
